body.p: An Owl saw two Rabbits playing close together, and seized them, one in each foot; but they were too strong for him, and ran away. The Owl's wife shouted to him, "Let one of them {321} go and kill the other!" but he replied, "The Moon will soon disappear, and then we shall be hungry. We need both of them." The Rabbits ran on; and when they came to a bowlder, one ran to the right side, while the other ran to the left side, of it. The Owl was not able to let go quick enough, and was torn in two.
